events.title: Canadian Stocks Turning In Mixed Performance As Investors React To Earnings
events.description: Canadian stocks are turning in a mixed performance on Friday with investors reacting to corporate earnings updates, and also weighing the potential impact of the resignation of Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang on the tech sector.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends On Weak Note
events.description: The Switzerland stock market ended modestly lower on Friday after languishing in negative territory throughout the trading session, as traders seemed reluctant to build up fresh positions amid a lack of positive news.

events.title: European Stocks End On Mixed Note After Cautious Session
events.description: European stocks turned in a mixed performance on Friday as investors made cautious moves amid uncertainty over the outlook for the AI trade and possibility of a rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December. Optimism about corporate earnings aided sentiment a bit.

events.title: U.S. Producer Prices Rise 0.3% In October, Slightly Less Than Expected
events.description: A report released by the Labor Department on Friday showed producer prices in the U.S. increased by slightly less than expected in the month of October. The Labor Department said its producer price index for final demand rose by 0.3 percent in October after surging by an upwardly revised 1.4 percent in September. Economists had expected producer prices to climb by 0.4 percent.

events.title: U.S. Producer Prices Rise Slightly Less Than Expected In October
events.description: A report released by the Labor Department on Friday showed producer prices in the U.S. increased by slightly less than expected in the month of October.

events.title: Bay Street Likely To Open On Mixed Note
events.description: Canadian stocks look heaed for a mixed start Friday morning, tracking the trend in the commodities markets, and weighing the impact of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.

events.title: Antipodean Currencies Fall Amid Risk-0ff Mood
events.description: The antipodean currencies such as the Australia and the New Zealand dollars weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday, as European shares dipped from record high amid uncertainty over the outlook for the AI trade and growing expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike in December.

events.title: FTSE 100 Roughly Flat In Lackluster Trade
events.description: U.K.'s equity benchmark FTSE 100 was up slightly a little over noon on Friday as investors made cautious moves, weighing the prospects of a rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December, and potential impact of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation on the technology sector.

events.title: NZ Dollar Drops Against Most Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar weakened against most major currencies in the European session on Friday.

events.title: Australian Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Friday.

events.title: French Stocks Turning In Mixed Performance In Cautious Trade
events.description: French stocks turned in a mixed performance Friday morning with investors largely making cautious moves, amid uncertainty over the outlook for the AI trade, and possibility of a rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December.

events.title: German Stocks Weighed By AI Uncertainty, Rate Hike Fears
events.description: German stocks declined Friday amid uncertainty over AI trade outlook and expectations for a December Fed rate hike. The DAX gained just 0.02%. Oil prices swung between gains and losses as Middle Eastern supply disruptions weighed on traders.

events.title: Indian Shares End Lower As Oil Prices, Yields Rebound
events.description: Indian shares ended Friday's session notably lower as Brent crude prices spiked above $96 a barrel and global bond yields jumped amid expectations that U.S. interest rates will stay higher for longer.
